prior_summary: Diffuse the desired peg pose in the observed hole frame, then convert that object goal through the freshly observed peg-to-TCP transform. This transports the complete insertion trajectory with a moved destination and retargets it for a modest changed rigid grasp offset.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when the peg is visibly retained and moves rigidly with the TCP, the hole may be displaced from the demonstrated world pose, or the incoming rigid peg-to-TCP grasp offset may differ modestly. The peg should be clear of the box, near axis alignment, and on a plausibly reachable collision-free route to the observed hole.
termination_guidance: Use only the unchanged task evaluator: peg-head x in the supplied interval, y/z within 0.009 m, axis alignment at least 0.985, and a stable held pose. Neither an estimated rigid transform nor successful IK is completion.
limitations: The demonstrations use one hole pose and nominal successes only. Accurate object/TCP observations and a rigid grasp are assumed. No contact truth or supervision covers slip, drop, collision, jam, retraction, regrasp, or retry; transported targets may be unreachable or unsafe after large changes.
